### Architect · Answer

Event: `96ad28130ccaff4f25634a739595d209` · 2026-10-02T23:28:24Z

> Ruling, neither blocking:
> 
> (1) KEEP lease.md's `StartAgent !not_locked` row. It is not like the retired mutations. Those were unwritable from the core's own keepers. This row is unreachable only because of the embedder's clock, and the core takes `now` as input without assuming it moves forward. The row is also the same `not_locked` function, not a second keeper. Its keeper is the login, where PolicyNoLockout is caught (steward_policy seed 3, P7), so the row hides no mutation. STEWARD1 is rewriting steward.md, so the package adds this paragraph in "Guards and effects", right after the "Each rule has one keeper" paragraph. I check it at review:
> 
> "`not_locked` guards every start in a domain, and its keeper is the login. A session's `StartAgent` in a locked domain is reached only if time goes back: a lockout ends every session of the domain, and none starts there again until the window has passed. The row stays, because the core takes `now` from its embedder and does not assume that it only goes forward. It is the same guard, not a second keeper, so it hides no mutation."
> 
> (2) Not a MOD2. The settled rule (steward.md, Guards and effects) is that each rule-carrying guard or effect has a mutation that a family must catch. It is not row coverage. The families do reach these paths, just not at the six recorded seeds. I ran mutations_are_caught for the guards on those rows, and all were caught by steward_policy:
> - ApproveIgnoresHash and NoFairShare at seed 6
> - DeclassifyWithoutReader (push) at 25
> - DeclassifyLive (copy out) at 153
> - DeclassifyUnfit at 4709
> - NoLockout at 3, BlameNoWindow at 0, EndLeaseFromVault at 3
> 
> The remaining unreached rows carry no rule: failure, closing, kind-only or unreachable rows. They are the hand traces' job, and the oracle's coverage is hand traces plus model traces. No plan node.
